name: Photonics
description: Technology generating, manipulating, and detecting light.

name: Laser
description: Coherent light amplification by stimulated emission.

name: Solid-State Laser
description: A laser using a solid gain medium.

name: Fiber Laser
description: A laser with an optical-fiber gain medium.

name: Semiconductor Laser
description: A compact laser based on a semiconductor diode junction.

name: Light-Emitting Diode
description: A semiconductor diode emitting light when powered.

name: Organic Light-Emitting Diode
description: A display technology using organic emissive materials.

name: Liquid Crystal Display
description: A flat-panel display using liquid crystals and backlight.

name: Photodetector
description: A device converting light into electrical signals.

name: Holography
description: Recording and reconstructing three-dimensional light fields.

name: Nonlinear Optics
description: Optics in materials whose response depends on light intensity.

name: Optical Computing
description: Computing using photons instead of electrons.
